note: Alberta Parks campground on rolling prairie near Dillberry Lake at the Alberta-Saskatchewan border, with stunted aspen and shrubs between sites; playground and fish-cleaning stations. Potable water only from June to mid-September. --Claude

The two small ponds west of the loops are about 1-1.5 ha each (under 5 acres, no value).

PIN (52.58390,-110.01380): at the north tip of the western loop (a camping loop); the herringbone loops' centre is ~250 m east. The page's directions point is 52.584093,-110.009919 (in the eastern loops, ~265 m east). Borderline; optional move to the page's point.
